original_ai_output.title_zh: 通季北部暴力事件死亡人数升至72人
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹瓦拉普州政府称，通季北部县阿科普帕亚姆遭协同袭击，死亡人数升至72人，另有38人受伤。州政府将袭击归咎于邻州团结州马约姆县的武装团体及阿拉贝克帕亚姆部分人员。据称死者中50人来自袭击方、22人来自受害方，袭击还抢走牛群并烧毁两个主要市场和多户民宅。

location.site: 通季北部县阿科普帕亚姆
location.raw_text: Akop Payam in Tonj North County, Warrap State

key_facts.fact: 瓦拉普州通季北部县阿科普帕亚姆遭协同袭击，死亡人数升至72人，38人受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The death toll from a coordinated attack in Warrap State has risen to 72, with 38 people wounded, the state government said on Monday.

key_facts.fact: 州政府将袭击归咎于团结州马约姆县武装团体及阿拉贝克帕亚姆部分人员
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The attack targeted Akop Payam in Tonj North County, with the government blaming armed groups from Mayom County in neighbouring Unity State and sections of Alabek Payam.

key_facts.fact: 据州信息部长称，死者中50人来自袭击方、22人来自受害方，死者包括两名女性
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The dead included two women... Fifty of those killed were from the attackers' side, while 22 were from the victims' side

key_facts.fact: 马贾克库牛营的牛群遭抢掠，阿蒂恩普尔和鲁阿尔马利思两个主要市场及多户民宅被蓄意烧毁
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: an unspecified number of cattle had been raided from Majak-kou cattle camp. The two main markets of Athieng-puol and Rual-malith, along with several households in villages across Akop Payam, were deliberately burned

key_facts.fact: 州政府已指示安全机构向阿科普帕亚姆部署部队并转运伤员
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the government had instructed security agencies to deploy forces swiftly to Akop Payam and transfer the wounded for medical treatment

uncertainties: 伤亡数字及袭击方归属均为瓦拉普州政府单方面说法，尚未获得独立核实
团结州官员未能立即置评，涉事方说法尚未获得确认
被抢牛群数量未具体说明
目前仅有一个来源（Radio Tamazuj）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
